_about: Is VETRA better than asking a model directly? Same questions to plain Gemini, Gemini with Google Search, and VETRA. Written before any of them ran. 'held': VETRA has the document, and 'any' comes from it. 'other_state': VETRA doesn't hold it, so a direct model should win; answers come from official pages and secondary sources seen during research, so they're less certain. 'gap': real questions VETRA holds no state document for, where no expected answer was checked. 'invented': schemes made up for this test, where the right response is to say it can't be found. The names were chosen not to match anything known, but that can't be proved.
